description:
Poliça's new album is "Better Live" — and frontperson Channy Leaneagh is totally cool with that 
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

For their latest album, the band Poliça tried something new: They performed a series of shows as part a February residency at Icehouse in Minneapolis, during which they set themselves the task of writing and recording a record — all before the live audience. The result is their new album, "Better Live," which released on February 26; the final recordings were made at Icehouse just eight days earlier, on February 18. 

During a visit to The Current's Morning Show, Poliça frontperson Channy Leaneagh talks about how this approach, and even the album title, "Better Live," really works for her because she prefers performing live to an audience rather than recording in a studio. Watch more of what Leaneagh has to say in the video above.

Credits
Guest – Channy Leaneagh of @polica 
Hosts – Nilufer Arsala, Zach McCormic
title: Channy Leaneagh of Poliça talks about recording live versus in a studio
